programme.title: LaLiga. "Osasuna" - "Real"
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Ang Babaeng Walang Pakiramdam
programme.desc: A woman diagnosed with a rare congenital disease that makes her incapable of feeling physical and emotional pain meets a man with cleft palate who makes her feel love like she never has before.

programme.title: S2pid Luv
programme.desc: George and Bin are orphans with dreams of making it big in the music scene. But when they leave the orphanage to try their luck, they end up as helpers in a junk shop.

programme.title: Para Kang Papa Mo
programme.desc: In the vibrant 1990s Philippines, the infectious trend of village-level dance contests echoes through communities. Young talents Anton, Ric, and Jose are at the heart of it. Yet, envy lurks in the shadows, a malicious force conspiring to dismantle their dreams.

programme.title: Hindi Tayo Pwede
programme.desc: Gabby (Lovi Poe) finds love in a man who is also named Gabby (Tony Labrusca) and shares a long and deep friendship with Dennis (Marco Gumabao).

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: More Than Blue
programme.desc: K (JC Santos) and Cream (Yassi Pressman) believe they're soulmates. When K finds out that he's dying, he thinks setting her free would be best for her.

programme.title: Exit Point
programme.desc: Because of prison overcrowding, 12 inmates were sent to an island where they must fight and survive for freedom.

programme.title: Working Beks
programme.desc: Five gay men from different walks of life are confronted with important choices that could change everything for them.

programme.title: Bukas May Umaga
programme.desc: Bukas May Umaga is a story of triumph in struggling for inner freedom and in search for justice of women violently victimized by raped.

programme.title: Alindog Ni Barbara
programme.desc: Though born twins, Barbara and Elena are worlds apart, Elena is bright and vigorous, while Barbara is mentally retarded. Upon seeing her dear friend's killing, Barbara discovers an unusual and menacing power she possesses: the power to annihiliate with her eyes.

programme.title: Ang Cute Ng Ina Mo
programme.desc: The story revolves around Georgia,a Filipina patis manufacturer and a mother who is finally reunited with her long-lost daughter after 20 years of separation.

programme.title: Tumbok
programme.desc: Cristine Reyes plays the role of Grace, wife to Carlo Aquino's character named, Ronnie, who just moved in an inherited condominium unit from the father of his husband which turn out to be hunted with ghosts. Their mishaps and misfortunes follow as they live there.

programme.title: Habangbuhay
programme.desc: A sheltered girl, who grew up in a very protective family, is asking a boy to fight for their love. If only he was not too consumed by his own battles.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: D' Uragons
programme.desc: Sherlock, a private detective helps Orot, a street-smart fellow who is caught in a dilemma. The two soon discover the syndicate behind the robbery.

programme.title: Pangarap Ko Ang Ibigin Ka
programme.desc: Although Rafael (Christopher de Leon) feels that he is not yet ready for another commitments, Alexis (Regine Velasquez) feels that he is the one she has been looking for.

programme.title: Mahal Kita, Final Answer
programme.desc: Nino is a self-starter who now lives a comfortable life. Meanwhile, Joanna is a cheerful person who has made a career out of joining all sorts of contests. When Joanna applied as Nino's assistant, he noticed the luck Joanna brought him so he decided to hire her.

programme.title: Bilib Ako Sa'yo
programme.desc: After losing his job for nearly losing a cargo of gold bars to hold-uppers, Gatdula finds himself working as a bouncer in a night club. There, he meets and is smitten by Varga.

programme.title: Strebel, Gestapo ng Maynila
programme.desc: The era when Western Police District was truly, Manila’s Finest. Major Robert Strebel is a policeman whose strongest trait is his strong sense of duty. A law enforcer who is willing to take the extra length to get his responsibilities done.

programme.title: Para Sa Broken Hearted
programme.desc: Three interweaving stories of broken hearts, that tackle the pain of heartbreak, acceptance, moving on and the courage to learn to love again.

programme.title: Siquijor: Mystic Island
programme.desc: Carlo takes the challenge and decides to shoot in Siquijor, an Island in the south well-known of its mysticism. But that's just the beginning of things to come. In the end, the crew learns that truth is indeed stranger than fiction.

programme.title: Dos Ekis
programme.desc: Benito met Charisse, a stripper and he immediately falls in love with her. Unknown to Benito, Charisse took a bag, which contained a large sum of money. Soon, the syndicate goes after them and their boring lives were never the same again.

programme.title: Sisterakas
programme.desc: The childhoods of Bernice (Vice Ganda) \u0026 Detty (Ai-Ai Delas Alas) were world's apart, but they did have one thing in common: their father. Headed by the eccentric yet equally brilliant \u0026 talented Roselle (Kris Aquino) the competition gets tougher, and a string of events lead to the two company heads fighting over the once expendable Detty.

programme.title: Babe, I Love You
programme.desc: Babe, I Love You circles on the story of two individuals who have never thought that love can blossom right at the middle of their two opposite worlds.

programme.title: Maria
programme.desc: When a former BlackRose cartel assassin deliberately betrays them by refusing to complete her mission, the cartel orders her execution. Unbeknownst to them, she fakes her own death and is able to create a new life of her own.

programme.title: Working Boys 2: Choose Your Papa
programme.desc: About the bums who need to strategize in life, the roles of the three are sloppy every time they strategize. All three are natural comics so they are very natural in their roles.

programme.title: Asin At Paminta
programme.desc: They are the most unlikely of tandems; two men whose only similarity is their gender.

programme.title: Nightshift
programme.desc: A young woman is stuck in the morgue - on her first day - working as an assistant to a pathologist when the dead begin to manifest signs of resurrection.

programme.title: Kahit Ayaw Mo Na
programme.desc: It follows Joey who is a fashion designer, Mikee who is a vlogger and Ally who is an aspiring composer. What seemed to be an ordinary trip to Samar turned out to be more than they presume.

programme.title: Catch Me… I'm In Love
programme.desc: A young girl with high ideals about romance is assigned to accompany the spoiled son of the president as he goes on an immersion trip. Coming from different worlds, the two find much to fight about. But an attraction soon grows between them.

programme.title: Mahal Kita, Final Answer
programme.desc: Nino is a self-starter who now lives a comfortable life. Meanwhile, Joanna is a cheerful person who has made a career out of joining all sorts of contests. When Joanna applied as Nino's assistant, he noticed the luck Joanna brought him so he decided to hire her.

programme.title: Luck At First Sight
programme.desc: Joma Labayen (Jericho Rosales) believes that a \"life charm\" would help him win money to pay for his debts. He accidentally meets Diane Dela Cruz (Bela Padilla), who gives him luck only when they are close to each other.

programme.title: Ikaw at Ako
programme.desc: From the challenges faced by a couple in their sunset years to the struggles of those in their mid-years, and the blossoming of a puppy love at a summer camp, this film explores the enduring power of love.

programme.title: Linlang
programme.desc: Rich, beautiful and in love, Lance and Lyra are an ideal couple. But the end of their blissful marriage begins when Lance meets Jill. The love triangle distorts their perspectives, and ultimately, it leads to a tragic death.

programme.title: Bugbog Sarado
programme.desc: Bugbog Sarado is a mystery drama revolving around two neighboring couples. More than a vicious plot of deceit and family trouble, this is a story of sodomy and masochism starring the country’s leading sexy stars.

programme.title: Double Barrel
programme.desc: A young impoverished couple work as hired killers.

programme.title: Won't Last A Day Without You
programme.desc: DJ Heidee (Sarah Geronimo) provides love advice to people who are having problems in their relationships. In the process of getting Melissa and Andrew together, Heidee begin to feel an attraction toward Andrew.

programme.title: Yung Libro Sa Napanood Ko
programme.desc: Lisa, a book author and Kim Gun Hoo, a Korean fan, meet and tour South Korea's towns together. As they spend more time with each other, Lisa eventually learns a past that apparently Gun Hoo was a big part of. Feeling confused and betrayed, Lisa disappears from his life again.

programme.title: Hari ng Selda (Anak ni Baby Ama 2)
programme.desc: Anghel is a convict feared and respected by the other inmates, the \"Hari Ng Selda\", in a prison operated by a cruel and abusive superintendent. He meets Angelica, a student on a school trip who is immediately drawn to him.

programme.title: Sumigaw Ka Hanggang Gusto Mo
programme.desc: Five murdered students, One terrified survivor, One mysterious killer on the loose.

programme.title: This Time
programme.desc: Coby and Ava only see each other during summer vacations. As time passes, the two develop feelings for each other but having a relationship long-distance is a great challenge for both.

programme.title: Sons of Nanay Sabel
programme.desc: After she was accused of being a negligent mother, Sabel's (Ai-ai delas Alas) wedding to Prince Harry was cancelled. To make things right, she embarks on a journey to find her estranged sons and reunite her family.

programme.title: Just A Stranger
programme.desc: A story of a woman and a man, half of her age being in love with each other despite the fact that they are both tied with someone else.

programme.title: Pangarap Ko Ang Ibigin Ka
programme.desc: Although Rafael (Christopher de Leon) feels that he is not yet ready for another commitments, Alexis (Regine Velasquez) feels that he is the one she has been looking for.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: A Glimpse of Forever
programme.desc: Glenda (Jasmine Curtis-Smith) pursues comfort in virtual dating to make up for the lack of romance from her real-life partner. But what was meant to be make-believe may turn out to be a genuine connection.

programme.title: Kainan Sa Highway
programme.desc: Kainan sa Highway is a story of survival, addiction for flesh and struggling for life.

programme.title: Para Sa Broken Hearted
programme.desc: Three interweaving stories of broken hearts, that tackle the pain of heartbreak, acceptance, moving on and the courage to learn to love again.

programme.title: The Exorsis
programme.desc: The film follows Gina, who must find an exorcist after her younger sister gets possessed by a dead woman's spirit.

programme.title: Akala Mo
programme.desc: Rizette (Judy Ann Santos) is a lady guard and is hopelessly in love with Eric (Dingdong Dantes), one of the tenants in the condominium where she is stationed.

programme.title: Kasangga... Kahit Kelan
programme.desc: For years, Bardo and Julie have been casting dark shadows over many streets--he as a hustler, and she as a thief. One day, they are yanked out from their world of petty crimes and find themselves being groomed as deep penetration agents.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: Glitter and Doom
programme.desc: Ride along on a surreal, glittery musical romance, all set to the hits of the iconic, Grammy Award-winning Indigo Girls. Serious musician Doom (Alan Cammish) and free-spirited circus kid Glitter (Filipino musical superstar Alex Diaz) start a budding summer relationship filled with camping trips, late-night conversations, and plenty of song and dance.
